text:
You need someone with AI knowledge who can help with getting LinkedIn accounts using AI and working with the LinkedIn platform.

I’m Noor Halden, with 6 years of experience in machine learning and NLP. I work with Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning. I can help design practical AI workflows for research, profile generation, and lead-generation support while keeping the process organized and efficient.

If you’re looking for someone who can combine basic AI use with platform-aware thinking, I’d be glad to help.
